subject: Build shared step_3_derive_params.py + contract JSON schema
description:
Port notebook cells 41-53 (EDA 3.13-3.19) to _shared_modules/step_3_derive_params.py, taking --category. Writes {category}_eda_findings.json -- THE CONTRACT.

F27: this JSON already exists and already carries all six params plus a _rationale string each. It is simply never read back. This task makes it an interface rather than a report.

EVERY FIELD MUST BE GENUINELY DERIVED (Brian: 'we also must make sure that it gets written by the pipeline steps dynamically, and is not a hard coded not code / data science derived values').

Already derived, keep as-is:
  LAGS -- lag corr |r|>0.1 in >=50% of stable brands + ACF/PACF
  ROLLING_WINDOWS -- predictive corr, collinearity-pruned
  HOLIDAY_MONTHS -- q75 threshold on monthly sales
  LOG_TRANSFORM_NECESSARY -- per-brand ADF majority vote

MUST BE FIXED (F28 -- look derived but are not):
  TRAIN_END / VAL_END -- currently absolute counts (train_periods=24, val_periods=6) with test as remainder. Replace with resolve_split_cutoffs() from engineer_features.py (already written in P0036 task 15). This is where the CSD half of that fix lands.
  MIN_PERIODS -- currently the literal 40 (export line 1612) with a rationale citing a computed brands_40, and filter_series claims it comes 'from EDA Step 3.05'. Compute from the brand-depth distribution and write with its real basis. SURFACE THE DISTRIBUTION -- the threshold CHOICE remains Brian's (P0036 task 8); this task only makes the value honest.

Verify: JSON validates; no field traceable to a literal; re-running on refreshed data moves TRAIN_END/VAL_END appropriately.
